messages.en: What are you doing?
You can change your profile picture now?
Does the profile picture option show up??
Huh? I don't have it.

messages.en: You can pick your profile picture later, but at least change your nickname first, please.

I updated it just recently though.

I'll go check and find out.
I just finished my schedule,
and I'm back at the dorm.
I'm exhausted.
You're really good at slicing sashimi...
Right?
Ever since doing Magical Girl,
I've been discovering talents I never knew I had.
I'm amazing.
I'm seriously good at everything. ㅋ

messages.ko: 이번 옵젝에서 마법소녀인 거 너무 티내던데? 그렇게 막 날아다니면 어떡해 나랑 더 멀어지자너;;;
messages.en: You made it way too obvious that you're a magical girl in this Objekt. Flying around like that just makes you even farther away from me...
No way. ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㅋ
I was so flustered.
During filming, I was right after Kim Chaewon.
Kim Chaewon did something weird too,

messages.ko: 멤버들 다 귀엽고 뭐 스포티한 이상한거 했겠지
messages.en: so I thought everyone probably did some cute or sporty weird pose.
That's what I thought...
But then there was one Supergirl mixed in among all the charismatic members.
I was so shocked.
That wasn't editing.
I actually flew.
Makes you fall for me, doesn't it?
If you're ever stuck in traffic, call me.
Just whistle once and I'll fly over.
I'll come pick you up.
So do I ride on top of you?
No.
I'll grab you with my toes like an eagle and fly.
Flap flap—it's Jeong Hayeon.
Call me if you're confident you won't fall.
Well... even if you fall for me,
it's okay—I'm Hayeon.
Ever since we talked about Minions last time,

messages.en: my algorithm keeps showing me things like 'Cute Bob Moments.'
He's seriously so adorable that I want to raise one.
I'd feed him bananas until his stomach bursts.
If I taught him Korean, he'd be so cute.
I'm good at Korean too...ㅠㅠ
That's cute~
I can't though.
Apparently not~
I seriously hate rain, you know?
I was really annoyed because of the rain today,
but after talking with y/n, even the rain started looking pretty. ㅋ
Oh, did I tell you this?
When I went on vacation to Gangneung,
I filmed a vlog
from the moment we left all the way until we ate sashimi and looked at the ocean.
But after that, I completely forgot.
The last video was,

messages.ko: 바다에 와써요~ 너무 이뻐용~ 카페가서 다시 킬게여~
messages.en: "We're at the beach~ It's so pretty~ We'll turn the camera back on after we go to the café~"
...and I never came back.
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋ
Then let's film the ending now.
Right now? ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅌㄹ

messages.ko: 다녀온지 며칠후인데요 서울 도착했고 밥 먹겠습니다……
messages.en: "It's been a few days since then, I'm back in Seoul, and now I'm going to eat..."
ㅋㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋ
Actually, except for filming when we first left,
all the other clips only happened because
my cousin kept saying, "Didn't you say you were making a vlog? Film this!!!"
Then I'd go, "Oh right. ㅎㅎ"
and film it.
I'm going crazy.

messages.ko: 반대로 내 브이로그 찍어줘도 볼거야? 육각로그
messages.en: Would you watch my vlog instead? A Hexagon-log.
I'd seriously love that.
I already know what my own daily life is like,
but is there nowhere I can watch all of your daily lives?
Please upload lots of them.
What if I just stay home all day?

messages.ko: 기상했습니다. 밥먹겠습니다. 하연이 영상 보겠습니다. 하연이 너무 이쁘네요. 잠 들겠습니다
messages.en: "I woke up. I'm going to eat. I'm going to watch Hayeon's videos. Hayeon is so pretty. I'm going to sleep."
Even something like that, upload it.
I woke up.
I ate.
I woke up.
I ate.
Good night~
...Were you talking about my daily life?
The video wouldn't even be a minute long.
Short-form videos are the trend these days...
I'll try filming a food vlog later.
Just a compilation of me eating.
Wouldn't that end up longer than a normal vlog?..
About an hour~?
It'll probably fit around 20 meals.
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㅋ
Wow, 20 meals in one day.
I never said it was one day...
Joobin already prescribed you to stop eating…ㅋㅋ
Dr. Joobin, my mouth won't listen to me.
What should I do?

messages.ko: 근데 나 맛있는거 먹을때 하연이 생각나
messages.en: Whenever I eat something delicious, I think of Hayeon.
Wow... that's love.
y.n, have you eaten?
I need to eat,
so recommend me something that's seriously delicious
and something I absolutely won't regret eating. Choose carefully.
If you don't eat kalguksu on a day like today, you'll regret it.
Wait.
I was thinking yesterday that I wanted kalguksu.
I have some well-aged
green onion kimchi
in my fridge. I'm going to eat it with that.
Did your mom make the green onion kimchi?
The delivery place did.
I'll just order it again.
Everyone, come over.
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋ
Let's all eat together.
I'll bring Yoajung...

messages.ko: 내가 어제 먹다 남긴 요아정 망고빙수 있어
messages.en: I still have leftover Yoajung mango bingsu from yesterday.

messages.ko: 우유아이스크림도 있고 불닭 까르보 불닭 다있어
messages.en: I also have milk ice cream, Buldak, and Carbonara Buldak.
Wow, a Hexagon Pig Party sounds great.
Let's all have a food feast~
I hope the day comes soon when I can just organize something like that myself.
I hope that day comes soon.
I'll keep working hard to earn enough seniority.
Just wait for me.
Don't gather everyone just so you can eat it all by yourself.
Is that a bribe?
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋ
Just watching you eat would make me feel full..
Then let's film something like that.

messages.ko: 2일 굶고 하연이 먹방보면 정말 보기만해도 배가 부를까?
messages.en: "If you don't eat for two days, will watching Hayeon's mukbang actually make you feel full just by watching?"
I don't think the views would be bad.
What about doing the opposite?
Even if I fasted for a week...
...I'd probably already be in another world..?
That's sad.
I have the biggest dilemma of my life.
Listen.
Clam kalguksu,
beef bone kalguksu,
or jang kalguksu...
Which one should I eat..?
Okay. Clam kalguksu wins by a landslide.
Kimchi dumplings or meat dumplings...
This one's really close...
Why did you choose that one?
I ordered kimchi dumplings.
ㅌㄹㅋㄹㅌㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㄹㅋㅋㄹ
Why are you all fighting over dumplings?
ㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㄹㄹㅋㅋ
Hey, hey. Stop fighting.
Unclench those fists~
Oh right. Yesterday,
I watched Card Garden's escape room video,
and
it looked so scary.
I want to film an escape room video too.
It looks like so much fun!
Hayeon, you'd be good at escape rooms, right..?
I'd probably just stay on the phone with the staff until I got out.
"I solved it!! What's the hint for the next puzzle?"
"I solved it! What's the hint for the next puzzle??"
I'd probably be like that.
If I had Ozone's role,
I would've seriously freaked out.
That's true.
I meant I'd defeat it in a cool way~
Why? Why?
I seriously love shows like The Great Escape.
I've watched all of them.
The Great Escape, Mystery Investigation Squad, Girls' High School Mystery Class, Zombieverse...
Shows like those.
I've watched all of them.
Hayeon... somehow you feel like you'd be Kim Dong-hyun's role in The Great Escape.
That's true...
But I understand how he feels.
Sometimes, when someone is just so incredibly athletic, you can't help but be amazed.
Baemin is getting rained on too...
Mr. Delivery Driver, please come safely, slowly... but quickly. 🙂
What if they end up delivering it on foot?
Should I fly over and pick it up with my toes?

messages.ko: 타자 계속 쳐서 엄지 완전 벌크업함
messages.en: I've typed so much that my thumbs have gotten totally buff.
They're going to be so sore tomorrow.
ㅋㄹㅋㅋㄹㅋㄹㅋㅋㅋ
I'm going to shower before the delivery arrives.
Sleep well.
Let's dream about each other~
Haranghae. 😍😍
